svg.title: Optical fibre — study visual
svg.desc: Study guide on optical fibre: types, advantages over copper, and last mile installations
svg.text: Optical fibre — the way of the future

g.text: Copper wire = most common. Optical fibre = rapidly growing. Fibre optic cabling is the future.
Network cable containing strands of glass fibres inside an insulated casing
Transmits data as pulses of light — not electrical signals
Uses a LASER to generate light
Traditional network cable requires special shielding to protect from electromagnetic interference

svg.text: Fibre vs copper — at a glance
Signal booster — amplificatore del segnale · amplifies weakening signals
Multi-mode fibre — fibra ottica multimediale · LEDs, shorter range
Single mode fibre — fibra ottica monomodale · laser, long range
Last mile — final connection from ISP network to homes/businesses
